name: minion-desktop
stderr:
minion-desktop: Minion is a Python program, and none of uvx, pipx or an installed minion command was found.
Install uv, which brings its own Python, then try again:

  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

Or install Minion with its one-line installer, which sets up uv too:

  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apophisss/minion/main/install.sh | sh

Desktops also need Docker, OrbStack or Podman: https://github.com/apophisss/minion/blob/main/docs/install.md
